add.text:
Ruby's Doghouse: same keyboard and couch-mouse update RetroBat just got (Steven asked for both to match).

1) Swap the Windows touch keyboard (TabTip) for the new controller keyboard: R:\HomeBox\Arcade\RetroBat\_Wizard\Program\scripts\PadKeyboard.cs. It is one C# 5 class (WinForms, no focus stealing, types through SendInput as Unicode), so copy it into Apps\HomeBoxHome\src and compile it in with HomeBox.cs. Its API: Open, Dismiss, IsOpen, Nav(dx,dy), Press, Backspace, Space, TypeEnter, CursorLeft, CursorRight, ToggleShift, Tick (call every ~16 ms). Map it Xbox style from XInput: D-pad or a left-stick flick moves (repeat after 380 ms, then every 90), A types, X deletes, Y space, LB/RB move the text cursor, LT shift, Menu = Enter and close, B close. Keep Menu opening it and the auto-open when a text box gets focus.
2) Two mice fight in RetroBat browser/Flash games: skip the Doghouse couch mouse (and its L3+R3 toggle) while the named mutex Local\RetroBatCouchMouse exists. RetroBat's own couch mouse already steps aside for Steam and Jackbox games whenever HomeBox.exe is running.
3) Start Steam with -silent at sign-in, after the R: drive shows up (homebox-startup.ps1), so Steam games never cold-start Steam (the pop-ups) and RetroBat never kills Steam mid cloud-save.

notes.fmw16steamrb: Built 2026-11-22, waiting on a test: PLAY now starts Steam quietly in the tray (-silent) so a Steam game never cold-starts Steam and RetroBat stops killing Steam when the game closes; RetroBat's menu is pulled back to the front when a game ends; Steam games get a both-sticks couch mouse (handed to the Doghouse when it runs).
notes.fmvv9xqib: Found the cause 2026-11-22: when RetroBat started Steam itself, it killed Steam the second the game closed (emulatorLauncher.log: 'Steam will be killed if not running before'), often mid cloud upload. PLAY now starts Steam ahead of time so it is never killed. Test: play a Steam game from RetroBat, quit, check the Library shows the cloud as up to date.
